newsitem.title: USA: Broward County, Fla., mulls school GO referendum.
newsitem.headline: Broward County, Fla., mulls school GO referendum.

text.p: Florida's Broward County School Board tentatively plans a bond referendum for May or June, and has directed its superintendent to prepare financial estimates, the Miami Herald said Wednesday.
At a meeting Tuesday, the board asked Superintendent Frank Petruzielo to estimate how much money the county needs to build and renovate schools and how much it can count on from the state.
The county last approved a GO bond referendum in 1987. In 1995, voters rejected a once-cent sales tax increase to fund school construction by a margin of nearly 3-1.
Board members said there was lilttle chance a new referendum would pass unless voters were convinced the proceeds would be spent evenly countywide.
